title: VFX trail strip
description: Landscape opaque pure-black strip with one horizontal streak that repeats seamlessly left to right, for trails, ribbons and beams.

guidance: Name the trail (for example sword slash, magic ribbon, energy beam, speed streak) and its colour.
The streak runs horizontally across the full width of the image and repeats seamlessly from the right edge to the left edge.
Keep the top and bottom edges pure black: the streak fades to black before it reaches them.
Ask for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background and a bright, saturated subject that works with additive blending.
No text, no scene, no characters, no perspective.
must_include: horizontal streak across the full width
avoid: visible seam at the left or right edge
streak touching the top or bottom edge

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear trail effect and its colour.
The prompt states that the streak runs horizontally across the full width and repeats seamlessly left to right.
The prompt asks for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background, dark top and bottom edges and a bright subject that suits additive blending.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example a seamless repeat and a streak that ends inside the frame).
image_rubric: The image shows one horizontal streak across the full width, as the prompt asked, without extra subjects.
The left and right edges match: no visible seam when the strip is repeated left to right.
The top and bottom edges are pure black; the streak does not touch them.
The background is pure black everywhere outside the streak; no grey haze, vignette or gradient.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.

constraints.background: Opaque pure black (#000000) background; the streak is bright and suits additive blending.
constraints.layout: Landscape strip; the streak runs horizontally across the full width and is tileable on the x axis only.
constraints.processing: Alpha extraction, channel packing and power-of-two resize are not asset-gen's job. The gen-run binds the output hashes and the image service ignores the requested size, so those transforms belong to the consuming package's import tool.
